name: Drum Bus, Glue
description: The second place, 0.8 s of release, and some 4 dB on the hits: the kit is held together and its room comes up between them.

name: Drum Bus, Pump
description: The first place, the fastest, and the threshold high: the reduction rises with every hit and lets go before the next, so the kit breathes in time.

name: Master, Gentle
description: The fifth place, automatic, and the threshold low on its dial: a dB or two on the loudest passages, let go over seconds, so the mix is held without being heard to move. The last device on the master.

name: Master, Middle and Side
description: The matrix on: the middle and the sides are compressed each by itself, so a loud center does not pull the width down with it. The fifth place.

name: Master, Program Leveler
description: The sixth place: a single peak is let go in a third of a second, many in ten, and a long loud passage in twenty-five, so a whole song is brought nearer one level, a few dB at the most.

name: Mix Bus, Warm Glue
description: The input 6 dB up, so the valves add their third harmonic, the threshold low, and the sidechain's filter in, so the low end does not pump the rest. The sixth place.

name: Parallel Crush
description: The input at its top and the threshold at the end of its dial, the valves well down and driven, and the mix at 40 %: the crushed and colored drums under the drums as they were, in one device.

name: Vocal, Smooth
description: The third place and the bias trimmer toward its top, which begins the reduction sooner and more gently: a voice is brought forward and evened out with no edge to it.
